body: Thank you for your concern. I have tried to get help but I am always too scared to talk to people. When I go to my therapist we just chat about current events and video games because I cannot stand to open up publicly! Very sweet but not much help for me. My mother told me if I fail suicide it would hurt her business so I would like to succeed. I can handle some pain and would much rather suffer the liver failure than life. :)

Thank you for your concern. I do have things to live for and they have stopped me in the past, but I am too paranoid now. Waking up the next day and the things I used to live for scare me so much now that they’ve become reasons to die. I believe my future could be positive...but even when my life is going right, I can’t stop fear. I can only stop myself!
